label: Israel-related
description: A roll call is labeled Israel-related when its bill or resolution title, amendment purpose, vote question, or vote description contains one of these words or phrases (whole words, case-insensitive; a hyphen and a space count the same, so 'anti-Semitism' and 'anti Semitism' match, but 'Semitism' on its own does not). Edit this list to change the rule; the next build applies it.
